command: addendum pre-registration: plan L L2 confirm read (pi0.5, 12 confirm tasks, dev protocol frozen)

metrics.demos: results/lang/pl2/demos.json (unchanged; cross-policy, fresh_ood_pl2d BASE 3300000); demo 0 selects, demo 1 scores

hypotheses.H1: pi0.5, l2sel > zs on the 12 confirm tasks x 20 episodes (exact sign test on discordant pairs, alpha 0.05)
